"""Read-only independent geometry audit of the frozen 1k Ceres state."""
import argparse, hashlib, json, math, struct, sys
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
sys.path.insert(0, "scripts")
from audit_colmap_pinhole_model import rotation
ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
ap.add_argument("--fixture",type=Path,required=True)
ap.add_argument("--state",type=Path,required=True)
a=ap.parse_args()
def rows(path):
 with path.open() as f:
  for line in f:
   if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"): yield line.split()
def rigid(v):
 values=np.array(list(map(float,v)))
 assert values.shape==(7,) and np.all(np.isfinite(values))
 return np.array(rotation(values[:4])), values[4:]
header={}; poses={}; points={}; iterations=[]; skip=None; section=None; ended=False
for v in rows(a.state):
 tag=v[0]
 if skip:
  if tag==skip: skip=None
  continue
 if tag in ["CERES_SUMMARY_MESSAGE_BEGIN","CERES_SUMMARY_FULL_REPORT_BEGIN"]:
  skip=tag.replace("_BEGIN","_END"); continue
 assert not ended
 if tag in ["OPTIONS_BEGIN","POSE_STATE_BEGIN","LANDMARK_STATE_BEGIN"]:
  assert section is None; section=tag; continue
 if tag in ["OPTIONS_END","POSE_STATE_END","LANDMARK_STATE_END"]:
  assert section==tag.replace("_END","_BEGIN"); section=None; continue
 if tag=="POSE":
  assert section=="POSE_STATE_BEGIN" and len(v)==9
  key=int(v[1]); assert key not in poses
  poses[key]=(np.array(list(map(float,v[2:]))),rigid(v[2:])); continue
 if tag=="LANDMARK":
  assert section=="LANDMARK_STATE_BEGIN" and len(v)==5
  key=int(v[1]); assert key not in points
  points[key]=np.array(list(map(float,v[2:])))
  assert np.all(np.isfinite(points[key])); continue
 if tag=="ITERATION":
  assert len(v)==17
  iterations.append(v); continue
 if tag=="END":
  assert section is None; ended=True; continue
 assert tag not in header,tag
 header[tag]=" ".join(v[1:])
assert ended and section is None and skip is None
assert header["VISLOC_BA_CERES_SOLVE_STATE"]=="1"
assert header["CERES_VERSION"]=="2.2.0" and header["FIXED_POSE"]=="0"
assert header["CERES_SUMMARY_IS_SOLUTION_USABLE"]=="1"
assert [int(v[1]) for v in iterations]==list(range(21))
assert int(header["ITERATION_COUNT"])==21
assert sum(int(v[3]) for v in iterations)==int(header["CERES_SUMMARY_NUM_SUCCESSFUL_STEPS"])
assert len(poses)==500 and len(points)==4716
original_poses={}; original_points={}; cameras={}; fh={}; fixed=[]
cost=error_sum=max_error=0.; mind=math.inf; maxd=0.; n=0
point_sums={}; point_counts={}; frame_counts={}
for v in rows(a.fixture):
 tag=v[0]
 if tag=="POSE": original_poses[int(v[1])]=(np.array(list(map(float,v[2:]))),rigid(v[2:]))
 elif tag=="LANDMARK": original_points[int(v[1])]=np.array(list(map(float,v[2:])))
 elif tag=="CAMERA": cameras[int(v[1])]=tuple(map(float,v[6:10]))
 elif tag=="FIXED_POSE": fixed.append(int(v[1]))
 elif tag=="RIG_OBSERVATION":
  fid,pid=int(v[1]),int(v[2]); xy=np.array(list(map(float,v[3:5]))); cid=int(v[5])
  R,t=poses[fid][1]; S,st=rigid(v[6:13]); p=S@(R@points[pid]+t)+st
  assert np.all(np.isfinite(p)) and p[2]>0
  fx,fy,cx,cy=cameras[cid]; residual=np.array([fx*p[0]/p[2]+cx,fy*p[1]/p[2]+cy])-xy
  squared=float(residual@residual); error=math.sqrt(squared)
  assert math.isfinite(error)
  cost+=squared; error_sum+=error; max_error=max(max_error,error)
  mind=min(mind,float(p[2])); maxd=max(maxd,float(p[2])); n+=1
  point_sums[pid]=point_sums.get(pid,0.)+error; point_counts[pid]=point_counts.get(pid,0)+1
  frame_counts[fid]=frame_counts.get(fid,0)+1
 elif tag!="END":
  assert tag not in fh; fh[tag]=" ".join(v[1:])
assert set(poses)==set(original_poses)==set(frame_counts)
assert set(points)==set(original_points)==set(point_counts)
assert fixed==[0] and n==130900 and len(cameras)==2
for tag in ["SOURCE_SHA256","SOURCE_SHA256_CAMERAS","SOURCE_SHA256_IMAGES","SOURCE_SHA256_POINTS","SOURCE_SHA256_MANIFEST","POSE_COUNT","LANDMARK_COUNT","OBSERVATION_COUNT","CAMERA_COUNT"]:
 assert header[tag]==fh[tag],tag
assert header["DECLARED_INITIAL_COST_BITS"]==fh["INITIAL_COST_BITS"]
assert float(header["DECLARED_INITIAL_COST"])==float(fh["INITIAL_COST"])
assert header["FINAL_POSITIVE_DEPTH"]==header["FINAL_OBSERVATIONS"]=="130900"
assert header["FINAL_ALL_OBSERVATIONS_VALID"]=="1"
reported=float(header["FINAL_FULL_SQUARED_COST"])
assert abs(cost-reported)<=1e-6+1e-10*abs(reported)
assert struct.unpack("<Q",struct.pack("<d",reported))[0]==int(header["FINAL_FULL_SQUARED_COST_BITS"])
assert abs(cost-2*float(header["CERES_SUMMARY_FINAL_HALF_COST"]))<=1e-6+1e-10*abs(cost)
assert cost<=float(fh["INITIAL_COST"])
center_changes=[]; rotation_changes=[]
for key,(raw,(R,t)) in poses.items():
 old,(R0,t0)=original_poses[key]
 center_changes.append(float(np.linalg.norm(-R.T@t+R0.T@t0)))
 rotation_changes.append(float(np.linalg.norm(R-R0)))
 if key==0:
  assert np.array_equal(raw[4:],old[4:])
  assert center_changes[-1]<1e-10 and rotation_changes[-1]<1e-10
point_changes=[float(np.linalg.norm(points[k]-original_points[k])) for k in points]
means=[point_sums[k]/point_counts[k] for k in points]
print(json.dumps({"state":str(a.state),"state_sha256":hashlib.sha256(a.state.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "fixture_sha256":hashlib.sha256(a.fixture.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
 "state_header":header,"pose_ids_exact":True,"point_ids_exact":True,
 "fixed_anchor_geometry_pass":True,"fixed_anchor_translation_bits_exact":True,
 "observations":n,"positive_depth":n,"supported_frames":len(frame_counts),
 "independent_full_squared_cost":cost,"reported_full_squared_cost":reported,
 "full_cost_absolute_difference":abs(cost-reported),"mean_observation_error_px":error_sum/n,
 "max_observation_error_px":max_error,"mean_point_error_px":sum(means)/len(means),
 "max_point_mean_error_px":max(means),"min_depth_m":mind,"max_depth_m":maxd,
 "max_pose_center_change_m":max(center_changes),"max_pose_rotation_frobenius_change":max(rotation_changes),
 "max_landmark_change_m":max(point_changes),
 "actual_updates_accepted":sum(int(v[3]) for v in iterations[1:]),
 "actual_updates_rejected":sum(1-int(v[3]) for v in iterations[1:]),
 "iteration_rows":iterations,
 "limitations":["No COLMAP model publication or GT scoring checked here.",
 "Image/keypoint/track identity binds through the separately audited frozen fixture."]},indent=2))
